Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was operating a sedan southbound when the vehicle came into contact head-on with a second sedan,
identified as operaetd by Driver 2, in a low-speed collision at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Driver 1 stated that
a passenger was saeted in the front right position at the time of impact. Officers on scene confirmed the presence of
the passenger in the vehicle, and no contrary account was offered by either driver. Driver 1 reported back strain and
said pain began shortly after the impact. It is not yet clear whether this injury was caused by this collision, and no
medical findings have been produced at this time. Scene photographs confirm the general positioning of both
vehicles and visible damage to the front ends. However, it is not clear whether all of the daamge observed came from
this impact. No prior damage to eihter vehicle is known to the reporting officer. No independent witnesses were
located, and the account rests on the statements of the drivers and the physical evidence photographed on scene.
Driver 1 is named on the insurance policy covering the sedan involved.
